2609.24815.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
2609.24815.paper_summary: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.
2609.24815.paper_summary_zh: 可擴展的模擬對於機器人數據生成、策略訓練、評估和安全迭代至關重要，但現實世界的互動成本高昂，傳統模擬器需要耗費大量人力來構建。我們提出了Uranus，一個基於聯合軌跡條件自回歸擴散模型的數據驅動機器人模擬器。Uranus提供了三個關鍵功能：(1) 流媒體、開放式的展開，能夠在線接收未來的關節位置軌跡並自回歸地每一步生成一個潛在幀，對應四個RGB幀，且沒有固定的時間範圍；(2) 低延遲生成，在推理優化後達到24幀每秒；以及(3) 可擴展、可延伸的機器人控制，提供一個統一的介面，用於在多樣的機器人實體和相機配置中進行同步的多視角生成。我們對內部分佈和外部分佈數據進行了全面的定量和定性評估，提供了對Uranus的客觀評估，並清楚地識別出其當前的局限性。我們發布了代碼和模型權重，以賦能社區，提供實用的工具和見解。
